image.name: librewolf
image.description: [LibreWolf](https://librewolf.net/) is a custom and independent version of Firefox, with the primary goals of privacy, security and user freedom. LibreWolf also aims to remove all the telemetry, data collection and annoyances, as well as disabling anti-freedom features like DRM.

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Rebase to Selkies, HTTPS IS NOW REQUIRED.
Publish aarch64 image. Switch to new upstream repo.

env_vars.name: LIBREWOLF_CLI
env_vars.desc: Specify one or multiple LibreWolf CLI flags, this string will be passed to the application in full.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

ports.desc: LibreWolf desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

custom.name: shm-size
custom.desc: This is needed for any modern website to function like youtube.

image.title: Librewolf
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  librewolf:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/librewolf:latest
    container_name: librewolf
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - LIBREWOLF_CLI=https://www.linuxserver.io/ #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/librewolf/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=librewolf \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e LIBREWOLF_CLI=https://www.linuxserver.io/ `#optional` \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/librewolf/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/librewolf:latest
